findings.F1: Across all Sunday bars, the Sunday return in usual daily moves predicts the opposite move: the slope of the excess 2-day return on it is -0.0058 (t -4.39, 4382 cases) and of the 3-day return -0.0092 (t -5.83, 4320 cases), while on all other days pooled it is +0.00003 (t 0.05) at 2 days, and the Sunday-versus-other-days difference in slope is -0.0058 (t -3.99).
findings.F2: Most of the reversal comes from which way Sunday moved, not from how far Sunday fell. Sunday-fall octiles are followed by excess 2-day returns of +0.56%, +0.93% and +0.85%, and Sunday-rise octiles by -1.33%, -1.33%, -1.20% and -0.67%. Within falls alone the slope on the fall's size is not significant (-0.0024, t -0.80, 2172 cases).
findings.F3: The test's own forecast, standardised over 60 bars and clipped to falls, gives a positive slope at every horizon, but its t sits right at the bar: 2.37 at 1 day, 1.12 at the plan's 2 days, 2.21 at 3 days and 2.19 at 5 days. Its top quintile (mean forecast 17.3) is followed by +0.26% over 2 days, less than the middle quintiles (+0.49%, +0.77%), so the largest forecasts do not carry it.
findings.F4: The two-sided Sunday reversal holds broadly. 17 of 19 coins (89%) have a negative 2-day slope, and 7 of 8 years are negative, with t -3.45 in 2020, -3.23 in 2025 and -2.14 in 2024; only 2022 is positive (+0.0056, t 1.67).
findings.F5: On the fall side alone, the 2-day slope changes sign from year to year (2018 t -2.08, 2021 t +2.79, 2022 t -1.08) and from coin to coin (TRX t +2.08, BTC t -1.17), and no more data is available, because the test already used every coin and fold listed.

ideas.idea: A coin's Sunday return (its Saturday-close to Sunday-close return, measured against its own recent daily volatility) is reversed over the next 3 days: the price moves against the Sunday move, and the larger the Sunday move in usual daily moves, the larger the move back.
ideas.consequence: A trader fading Sunday moves should fade both Sunday rises and Sunday falls, sized by the Sunday move, and hold into midweek rather than only through Monday.
ideas.name: Sunday move reverses midweek
